title: Save scientific terminology from executive orders | Science
description: The US National Library of Medicine (NLM) maintains the controlled vocabulary used to index the global biomedical literature, and its medical subject heading of “Artificial Intelligence” has been in use since 1986 (1). However, on 29 September 2026, US President Trump ordered federal executive agencies to replace the term “artificial intelligence” with the term “super intelligence” in official documents, communications, websites, reports, and policy papers (2). Compliance with the September order is already underway: The National Institute of Standards and Technology has relabeled its evaluation research on language models and agents as super intelligence research (3). As medical researchers who depend on consistent and searchable literature, we urge US federal agencies to exempt scientific publications and controlled vocabularies from the order.
